name: [UPD] Blood Lab
desc:
Your own private lab. A room full of NPCs. 14 weapons. Blood that moves like a real fluid.

Watch it spray, splat, drip down walls and pool on the floor, all in chunky cubes. Every litre you spill unlocks new weapons and NPC models.

Pick your layout, choose your blood colour and bring your friends.

How much can you spill?

llm.loop: enter a private lab -> use weapons on NPCs -> spill litres of fluid blood -> unlock more weapons and NPC models
llm.objectives: spill as much blood as possible
llm.progression: litres spilled unlock weapons and NPCs
llm.instructions: pick a layout and blood colour, bring friends, see how much you can spill
unique: voxel fluid blood simulation as core toy
llm.thumbnails: noob splattered with yellow blood, weapon rack
llm.complexity_notes: custom fluid sim is technically demanding; small map
